meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会守着同一个 pull request 不放:反复看它的评论、review 和 CI 状态;发现真问题会动手修,并把修改传回分支;涉及生成产物会先核对再处理旧评论。直到能合并才收工。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit”或“monitor”,或要求“一直盯着这个 PR,把评论、review、CI 都处理完,直到能合并”时触发。

say.text: 帮我看着这个 PR,评论清完、检查通过再告诉我。
say.note: Claude 会反复巡查到能合并才停。

say.text: Babysit 一下 #12,把 review 里能修的问题都修掉。
say.note: 会写修复提交、跑相关测试后推回分支。

say.text: 有新评论就继续处理,直到这个 PR 能合并。
say.note: 机器人提的意见会先对照代码核实再动手。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude watches one pull request until it can merge: it re-checks comments, reviews and CI status, fixes real issues and pushes commits, and checks source vs generated artifact before closing old threads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep watching a PR's comments, reviews and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Watch this PR for me; tell me when the comments and checks are clean.
say_en.note: Claude keeps polling until it is safe to merge.

say_en.text: Babysit #12 and fix the issues that can be fixed in the review.
say_en.note: Claude runs the tests/builds and pushes fixes back.

say_en.text: Keep handling new comments until this PR can be merged.
say_en.note: Bot reports are verified against the code first.
